evidence.reason: The parent calls os.fork() at line 961 while cooldown_write() is held, but adds the child to active only at line 1001 after the parent branch closes refused_w. A KeyboardInterrupt delivered in that window unwinds the lock context before active[pid] exists; the child can publish b'a' and enter drain_item while cleanup has no record to reap. The existing comment at lines 998-1000 confirms active is used so cleanup does not release service.lock beneath an admitted child, so this interruption gap is a real implementation race, not a new requirement.
